tagline: Concrete Flatwork: Patios, Driveways & Garage Floors in Kimberly
ownerStory: Specializing exclusively in residential concrete flatwork across Kimberly, Little Chute, Appleton, and the Fox Valley. Peskie Contracting pours custom concrete patios, walkways, driveways, decorative stamped slabs, and durable garage floors built to stay flat through Wisconsin freeze-thaw winters.

services.name: Poured Concrete Driveways & Aprons
services.desc: Full tear-out and new concrete driveway pours on a 6-inch compacted gravel base with tied rebar reinforcement and air-entrained 4,000+ PSI concrete. Precision broom finishes and clean control joints keep driveways in Kimberly and the Fox Valley crack-resistant year-round.

services.name: Concrete Patios & Outdoor Living Slabs
services.desc: Custom-formed backyard concrete patios engineered with proper water-shedding slope, smooth or broom textures, and crisp picture-frame borders. Built as an everyday gathering space that stands up cleanly to Fox Valley seasons.

services.name: Walkways, Sidewalks & Entry Stoops
services.desc: Straight or curved front walkways, city sidewalk replacements, and poured entry steps finished with clean edges and safe slip-resistant broom texture for lasting curb appeal.

services.name: Decorative & Stamped Concrete
services.desc: Architectural ashlar slate, stone patterns, textured borders, and integral color blends sealed with high-solids UV and road-salt protection for one-of-a-kind patios and entryways.

services.name: Garage Floors & Monolithic Shop Slabs
services.desc: Laser-leveled concrete garage floor replacements and pole-barn or shop slabs with compacted granular fill, vapor-barrier prep, power-troweled smooth finish, and early-entry saw cuts.
